name: Venerating Saints
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between honoring faithful believers and the improper veneration of saints or images. While Hebrews encourages us to remember and emulate the faith of godly leaders as a cloud of witnesses surrounding us, passages like Isaiah 42:8 warn against giving God's glory or praise to graven images. The account in Acts 10:25, where Cornelius worships Peter and is corrected, further illustrates that worship is due to God alone. Thus, honoring saints must not cross into idolatry or worship, maintaining Christ as the sole object of praise and devotion.
